guidance: Rest well and stay hydrated. Warm fluids like tea or soup can soothe a sore throat. Standard supportive care resolves this within 7-10 days.
precautions: Cover mouth when coughing or sneezing

guidance: Monitor temperature. Stay hydrated, rest, and keep room ventilated. Consult a physician if fever goes above 103°F (39.4°C) or lasts more than 3 days.
precautions: Avoid cold baths which can trigger shivering and raise internal temperature

guidance: Rest completely. Drink plenty of water and warm teas. Use throat lozenges. Watch for breathing issues or chest pain.
precautions: Wash hands and sanitize frequently touched surfaces

guidance: Requires professional medical monitoring. Focus on hydration. Avoid pain relievers like aspirin or ibuprofen as they can worsen bleeding risks. Seek emergency care if warning signs (bleeding, persistent vomiting, severe belly pain) appear.
precautions: Avoid NSAIDs (aspirin, ibuprofen) - use only doctor recommended fever reducers
Use mosquito nets and repellents to prevent transmission

guidance: Consult a doctor immediately for blood testing and antimalarial prescription. Recovery requires specific antiparasitic drug courses. Keep hydrated and rest.
precautions: Prevent mosquito bites using repellents and protective clothing

guidance: Consult a healthcare provider for antibiotic prescription. Drink boiled or purified water. Eat plain, easy-to-digest cooked meals.
precautions: Maintain strict hand hygiene before eating and after using washrooms
Avoid raw foods, unpasteurized milk, and ice made from untreated water
